source.title: Vaesen: Nordic Horror Roleplaying
source.note: Talent and equipment effects are paraphrased; flavor and suggestions follow the supplied archetype example.

archetype.name: Academic
archetype.flavorText: We all agreed that it was theoretically possible to give those who are not verum videntes, or so-called Thursday's Children, the ability to see vaesen. The others quickly forgot our discussion. For me, the issue became an obsession. And not only a theoretical one. If people around us could see the truth, we would become the leaders of the new world. A text written by a Sufi philosopher from Kottayam mentioned a dark fluid which, after translation, was called Black Mud. Drinking it causes creatures to emerge. I had to sell much of my mother's jewelry to have a merchant bring a jar of said mud back to Upsala. And now, here it is, on the desk before me.
traumaOptions: Vaettir turned you into a rat
Aged by the magic of a mermaid
Watched your partner being torn apart by a giant
darkSecretOptions: Stole or falsified documents to get research results
relationshipOptions: I cannot stay calm in your presence

talents.name: Bookworm
talents.description: Add +2 to Learning when searching books or libraries for clues.

talents.name: Erudite
talents.description: A successful Learning test lets you establish facts about a place or phenomenon. The GM decides what is appropriate and reasonably within your knowledge. This cannot establish facts about vaesen.

talents.name: Knowledge is Reassuring
talents.description: Condition penalties do not apply to your Learning tests.

items.name: Book collection
items.description: Provides +1 to Learning when consulting the collection for information.

items.name: Map book
items.description: Provides +1 to Investigation or Learning when using maps to navigate.

items.name: Writing utensils and paper
items.description: Provides +1 to Investigation when taking notes.

items.name: Liquor
items.description: Provides +1 to Inspiration when using alcohol to inspire others.

items.name: Slide rule
items.description: Provides +1 to Learning when performing calculations.
